lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zài yī jiā gōngsī gōngzuò.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 我是经理。每天开会，看文件。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shì jīnglǐ. Měitiān kāihuì, kàn wénjiàn.
lines.english: I'm a manager. Every day I have meetings and read documents.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 很忙。但是我喜欢我的工作。
lines.pinyin: Hěn máng. Dànshì wǒ xǐhuan wǒ de gōngzuò.
lines.english: Very busy. But I like my job.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 他们很友好。我们常一起吃饭。
lines.pinyin: Tāmen hěn yǒuhǎo. Wǒmen cháng yīqǐ chīfàn.
lines.english: They're very friendly. We often eat together.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 真好！希望你的工作越来越好！
lines.pinyin: Zhēn hǎo! Xīwàng nǐ de gōngzuò yuè lái yuè hǎo!
lines.english: That's great! I hope your work keeps getting better!
